summary: Climber in a group of five seriously injured in a witnessed fall while descending Crestone Needle; Flight for Life inserted a technical rope team and the victim was hoisted by a Colorado National Guard helicopter
responding_agency: Custer County SAR, Saguache County SAR, Flight for Life, Colorado National Guard, Colorado Hoist Rescue Team, Western Mountain Rescue Team, Alamosa Volunteer SAR
notes: Date 2026-09-07 corroborated by Custer County SAR Facebook posts of 2026-09-08 (mission recap: technical rope team inserted, subject hoisted 15:44); blog (Sept 2026) said the fall occurred on a Monday. FB post also names Colorado Hoist Rescue Team, Western Mountain Rescue Team, Alamosa Volunteer SAR on scene. 2026-09-18: merged Wet Mountain Tribune report (Labor Day fall, group-of-5/Guard hoist match).
